text:
Most people hunt for a locker
by Kyoto Station's main Karasuma exit. 🧳

But the biggest cluster of suitcase lockers
is on the other side.
The Hachijo side, where the Shinkansen stops.

Would you hunt for a locker,
or send the case to your hotel? 👇
